mandatory_gates.N1: case count and scenario hash match the frozen manifest
mandatory_gates.N2: all analytic values are finite and every critic strong-convexity constant is positive
mandatory_gates.N3: at least 50% of all owner cases are jointly nonvacuous within 8192 charged transitions
mandatory_gates.N4: median minimum jointly nonvacuous charged transitions is at most 16384
mandatory_gates.N5: at least 25% of horizon-at-least-4 owner cases are jointly nonvacuous within 16384 charged transitions
mandatory_gates.N6: the audit uses zero coordinate variance, zero staleness and no actor critic bias beyond the declared exact critic radius

decision_rule: Any failed mandatory gate stops the per-packet high-probability safety-shield route. It does not invalidate the conditional theorem or authorize sampled efficacy.
